scope: Exact Debian Rust source archive, Debian packaging/patches and DSC only. Full upstream COPYRIGHT read; complete Debian copyright file inspected through all file/author/comment metadata and license definitions, previously read complete grant comparisons, all new operative clauses read, and full CC-BY4 word differences read. All four original font permission files newly retained and read in full; no SDK or OS parent clearance.
conditions: Keep full original Rust and every vendored component copyright, license, disclaimer, modification and nonendorsement notice, choosing MIT where expressly offered while preserving all alternatives and independently licensed files.

Provide exact preferred code, Debian patches and full build/install configuration. Keep GPL2-or-later build scripts and MPL2-covered files under their own licenses with complete corresponding sources available to binary recipients.

Retain original NCSA/MIT/Clay/libbacktrace attribution, LLVM exceptions and full Apache license without extending exception scopes. The removed LLVM submodule is not represented as supplied by this Debian DFSG archive.

Bundle unmodified fonts with their four complete original OFL1.1 notices and all reserved font names; do not sell fonts alone, relicense them, use reserved names for modified fonts or imply endorsement. Debian copyright OFL transcription truncates its disclaimer; original complete font notices are retained alongside it.

Keep Rust-logo CC-BY4 original credit, source reference and license unchanged as upstream source attribution; it is not Shirube OS product branding. No extra restrictions or DRM apply to covered CC-BY4 material. Preserve CC0 waiver/fallback only for its stated work, with no implied patent/trademark rights.
